note: _spatium peccandi_ (Clementina, Weber/Gryson, NVg) – licence to sin (literally: space to sin). On the basis of an ancient quotation, Nestle suggests _laxamentum peccandi_ as the original Vetus-Latina reading. – Eberhard Nestle: Sirach, Book of. In: James Hastings (ed.): _A Dictionary of the Bible_. Volume 4. Edinburgh 1902 (xi, 994 pp.), pp. 539–551, at p. 546.
